mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, i.member_no AS memberNo, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, i.category, i.title, i.content, i.secret_yn AS secretYn, i.status, i.view_count AS viewCount, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.updated_at AS updatedAt, i.delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry i JOIN member m ON i.member_no = m.member_no WHERE i.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
UPDATE inquiry SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo}
